actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Small Business and Entrepreneurship.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 415 - 8 (Roll no. 49). (text: 2/24/2025 CR H746)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 415 - 8 (Roll no. 49). (text: 2/24/2025 CR H746)
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H824)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 804.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H745-746)
Mr. Williams (TX) moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Referred to the House Committee on Small Business.

dimensions.assessment: Affects small business owners and individuals located in designated rural disaster areas.
dimensions.evidence: individuals located in rural areas... for which a disaster declaration has been made

dimensions.assessment: Directs administrative adjustments in outreach and marketing materials rather than creating new financial assistance programs or altering loan terms.
dimensions.evidence: providing targeted outreach and marketing materials to such individuals

dimensions.assessment: The source does not state any specific federal spending or economic impact figures.
Instructs the SBA's Office of Disaster Recovery and Resilience to modify administrative outreach practices and makes a minor technical statute-of-limitations correction.
dimensions.evidence: ensure that the Associate Administrator... takes such actions as necessary to ensure that individuals located in rural areas... have full access

dimensions.assessment: Requires implementation actions within one year of enactment with permanent ongoing operational relevance for future rural disaster declarations.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act

missing_information: Estimated cost of implementing the targeted outreach and marketing materials.
importance_detail.rationale: H.R. 804 directs the Small Business Administration to ensure full access to disaster assistance for individuals in rural disaster areas through targeted outreach and marketing.
